# Global Style Reference (Promptly Landing)

Use this document as a style anchor when prompting AI to generate UI or copy for the main landing page. Preserve the overall mood, visual grammar, and component rhythm described below.

## Brand Character
- Tone: confident, modern, admin-focused, productivity-forward, optimistic.
- Visual feel: crisp, bright, high-contrast accents, soft gradients, glassy layers, generous whitespace.
- Message framing: conversational AI for admin automation, concrete outcomes (speed, error reduction), enterprise credibility.

## Typography
- Primary fonts: Space Grotesk + Manrope (already loaded). Use bold, tight tracking for headlines.
- Headline scale: 3xl-7xl with strong weight; keep line-height tight for hero and section titles.
- Body copy: 16-20px equivalent, relaxed line-height.
- Microcopy: uppercase tracking-wide for labels and eyebrow text.

## Color System
- Base: white backgrounds with slate text.
- Primary accent: blue-600 (CTAs, emphasis, highlights).
- Secondary accents: teal-500/600, indigo-500/600, rose-500/600.
- Neutrals: slate-900 for headings, slate-600 for body, slate-300 for muted labels.
- Gradients: blue to cyan for hero text and CTA blocks.

## Layout & Rhythm
- Section spacing: large vertical padding (py-24 typical).
- Containers: max-w-7xl with horizontal padding.
- Hero: centered, wide headline, supportive paragraph, strong CTA row.
- Flow: hero -> brand marquee -> features -> how it works -> live demo -> metrics -> CTA -> footer.

## Visual Motifs
- Soft, blurred orbs in hero background.
- Rounded corners: 2xl to 3xl for cards; full for pills.
- Shadows: strong for hero media, subtle for cards, inner shadow for charts.
- Marquee brand row with edge fades.
- Glassy overlays and subtle gradients.

## Interaction Patterns
- Hover: elevate or scale cards; subtle color shifts.
- Buttons: bold, rounded, high contrast; primary filled + secondary outlined.
- Motion: light animations (fade-in, marquee, ping, bounce) used sparingly.

## Component Cues
- Header: fixed, translucent, blurred, thin border.
- Hero: gradient-highlighted keyword, CTA pair, media preview with play button.
- Features: grid of cards with hover reveal details.
- How it works: dark section with gradient bubbles and step flow.
- Demo: split layout with prompts + chat window.
- Metrics: split layout with stats and chart.
- Footer: dark, multi-column, subdued links.

## Copy Guidance
- Keep verbs active and clear (automate, analyze, execute).
- Avoid jargon unless it adds credibility (RPA, OCR, RBAC).
- Tie features to outcomes (time saved, error reduction).
- Use short punchy subheaders with 1-2 sentence support.

## Do / Do Not
- Do: use blue as primary brand anchor, keep whitespace generous, maintain rounded UI shapes.
- Do not: introduce dark-mode themes or muted, low-contrast palettes.
- Do not: switch to different font families or remove gradient accents.
